maddeler.e:
نفتضح (form VIII)
# نَفْتَضِحُ (naftaḍiḥu) /naf.ta.dˤi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# نَفْتَضِحَ (naftaḍiḥa) /naf.ta.dˤi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# نَفْتَضِحْ (naftaḍiḥ) /naf.ta.dˤiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
